content: <thought>First, find a retrosynthetic template for forming a sulfonamide (S(=O)(=O)–N) by coupling a sulfonyl chloride with an amine. Then find a template for forming a carbamate (Boc protection) by reacting a secondary amine with tert‑butyl chloroformate. Finally, find a template for a Buchwald‑Hartwig C–N coupling to attach the piperazine‑derived nitrogen to the polycyclic aromatic bromide. After obtaining suitable template IDs, verify each step with the provided tools and check that all leaf precursors are commercially available and inexpensive.
